title: Hold a builder's licence
what: Hold the state's builder (or building contractor) licence or registration before contracting for or carrying out building work.

sources.title: Building Act 1993 (NT)
sources.quote: A person must not commence or continue to carry out prescribed building work unless the person is: (a) a building contractor registered to carry out the building work as specified in the Regulations;

reach.note: Calibration: house construction; other building classes follow in phase D.
